question: How should the morning debrief gather its data?

options.name: Agent calls existing tools
options.description: A play tells the agent to call inboxWaiting, twitterNotifications, sessionsCheck and governorShow each morning and assemble the debrief itself.

options.name: One read-only command
options.description: A new `log inbox debrief --since <time>` reads log.db once and returns new messages per platform, waiting, follow-ups, X notifications and account health, compact and under 40 KB, as one MCP tool.

options.name: Watchers keep a running debrief
options.description: The account watchers update a debrief table in log.db as messages land; the morning job only reads that table.

criteria.question: How long does the whole morning agent turn take at p99, counting model round trips, not just tool time?
Does it run in Hermes cron, where log tools not annotated read-only are refused?
How likely is it to miss or misreport something (a misspelt name, a late backfill, a thread cut short)?
How much work to build and keep working, given the files already being changed elsewhere?

question: How should the debrief rank opportunities?

options.name: Rules over log.db
options.description: Score each thread from signals log already has: money words and amounts, deal or client labels, how long they have waited, whether the owner asked them something, whether they are in a money band from the owner's own scored list.

options.name: SubQ reads each thread
options.description: Batch the waiting threads to SubQ decisions with the owner's goals (base or retainer partnerships, clients, leads) and take its choice per thread.

options.name: Rules first, SubQ for the top
options.description: B for every thread, then C only on the top 10 to order them and write one line why.

criteria.question: Would the top 5 match what the owner would have picked (deals, money, warm leads first)?
Money and time per morning run?
Can the owner see why each item is ranked where it is?

question: Where should the debrief be delivered?

options.name: Today page
options.description: The Hermes Today page shows the debrief as blocks, refreshed by the cron job.

options.name: Telegram message
options.description: The cron job delivers a rendered PNG and a short text to the owner's Telegram.

options.name: Chat reply only
options.description: The debrief appears as a reply in the Hermes chat when he opens it.

criteria.question: Will the owner see it within minutes of waking, on his phone, while travelling?
Can he act on an item straight from it (draft a reply, open the chat)?
